title: GLM 5.3 Flash locator mode comparison against human crosswalk
dataset: dataset-v3, same frozen 16 packets and 86 eligible human crosswalk targets
interpretation: JSON-object mode increased schema-valid packets by one and reduced provider attempts, but human item-and-boundary hits decreased by one and timing recall was unchanged. Both arms had three explicit single-request free-tier size rejections. The bootstrap intervals are wide and overlap; this sample does not establish a quality improvement.
retry_comparability_note: The JSON-object arm used the route-aware direct LiteLLM path, which can make one provider-side Pydantic correction attempt, plus the locator runner’s one repair. Request counts are observed provider calls, not a sustained v2 Worker retry/capacity benchmark.
